title: The sacraments and grace
tagline: The Eucharist and Real Presence, confession, baptism and anointing, and answers to “why a priest?”.
whyItMatters: The sacraments are how Catholics meet Christ, and also where many Protestants and secular friends have questions. Knowing the Scripture and early Church behind them builds confidence.

mindset.tip: Ask what the person has seen of the sacraments; many objections are against a caricature.
Remember Lutheran, Anglican and Orthodox Christians also believe in the Real Presence; start from what we share.
Never use the Eucharist as a weapon; Christ is truly there. (1 Corinthians 11:27-29)
Explain that priests act in Christ’s name; God alone forgives. (John 20:21-23; CCC 1441-1445)
